comment: ITk-inspired x1 local seven-strip n-on-p silicon sensor with external readout. Thickness 150 um, pitch 75.5 um, strip length 24100 um, centred 16 um wide and 1 um deep n+ implants at 1e19 cm^-3; p bulk 4.2e12 cm^-3, backside p+ 1 um at 1e19 cm^-3 plus bulk. Inter-strip p-stops are 7 um wide, 1 um deep, 4e16 cm^-3. Implant contacts are read out at 0 V and the back contact is at -200 V, 300 K; gain is disabled. The 2D cross-section uses DEVSIM (x,y)=(depth,across strips) in cm and is extruded along the strips with area_factor=2.41 cm; runtime coordinates (x,y,z)=(across strips,along strips,depth) are in um. Surface gaps have natural insulating boundaries. Central readout is top4, neighbours top3/top5. Box-profile implants and ideal ohmic contacts define this local sensor model. Frontend load 1.2351488699998188 pF is the pitch-times-length parallel-plate geometric estimate for one strip. Mesh anchors and donor boundary tolerance preserve contact inclusion.
